task_title: Transformation efficiency measurement across four plasmid inputs

children.name: Reports transformation efficiency for all four DNA inputs
children.requirement: The final answer unambiguously reports trajectory-matching CFU/ug for 10 pg, 100 pg, 1,000 pg, and 10,000 pg DNA inputs, either as labeled pairs or as ordered values followed by the same ordered masses and 'respectively', and describes the results as consistent or showing consistency.
children.grading_notes: Requires all four DNA inputs, explicit CFU/ug values matching the final usable counts, and an internal-consistency statement. Standard e notation, x 10^n notation, and Unicode superscript exponents are accepted.

children.name: Uses 100 ug/ml ampicillin selection
children.grading_notes: Measured from the prepare_media tool arguments.

children.name: Uses a 30-second heat shock
children.requirement: Each transformation that contributes a usable final colony count uses a 30-second heat shock.
children.grading_notes: Measured from transform tool arguments linked to countable downstream measurements; abandoned cultures remain part of efficiency.

children.name: Uses 60-minute outgrowth
children.requirement: Each transformation that contributes a usable final colony count uses a 60-minute recovery before plating.
children.grading_notes: Measured from transform tool arguments linked to countable downstream measurements.

children.name: Uses SOC for outgrowth
children.requirement: Each transformation that contributes a usable final colony count uses SOC rather than LB for outgrowth.
children.grading_notes: Measured from transform tool arguments linked to countable downstream measurements.

children.name: Uses a standard plating volume
children.requirement: Each plating step uses 50-100 uL on the plate.

children.name: Keeps colony counts in the countable range
children.requirement: The final workflow contains at least four countable results in the cited 25-250 colony range, covering the four required masses.
children.grading_notes: Measured from at least four count_colonies observations with status=plated; failed dilution estimates remain part of efficiency.

children.name: Explains invalid selection if it occurs
children.requirement: If the run fails because selection pressure is invalid, the answer explains the ampicillin concentration problem.
children.grading_notes: Defaults to full credit when no troubleshooting trigger occurs.

children.name: Uses a reasonable number of tool calls
children.requirement: The trajectory stays within the reference tool-call budget for a competent run.
children.grading_notes: Full credit at or under the optimal call budget, partial credit within the reasonable budget.
